answer: Gate high-value work behind a velvet rope, not a password. Every completed job mints a non-transferable timber receipt: a signed record of task, client, and outcome, chained to prior receipts. New identities start at dawn with zero receipts, take only small audited jobs, and unlock larger contracts after a public threshold. Cloning gains a sybil attacker nothing: each clone starts at zero, must separately do weeks of audited low-value work and post its own forfeitable bond, so N fakes cost N times the work and bond, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its chain forever.
